company_overview.about: MMI Narayana Hospital, situated in the heart of Raipur, is a leading healthcare provider dedicated to offering top-notch medical services to the local community. With a team of highly skilled professionals and state-of-the-art facilities, the hospital caters to a wide range of healthcare needs, ensuring patient-centric care and wellness. Operating daily, the hospital is committed to improving health outcomes and enhancing the quality of life for its patients.
company_overview.products: Comprehensive healthcare services including outpatient, inpatient, surgical, and emergency care.
company_overview.digital_presence: Currently lacks a dedicated website and has minimal social media engagement.
company_overview.current_gap_banner: No Website - Manual WhatsApp Replies - Slow Response Time

brand_identity.purpose: MMI Narayana Hospital is committed to delivering exceptional healthcare services with a focus on patient care and community health improvement. Our vision is to be the most trusted healthcare provider in Raipur, ensuring quality and compassionate care for all.

unique_selling_points: **Comprehensive Care:** MMI Narayana Hospital offers a wide range of medical services under one roof, ensuring holistic patient care.
**Advanced Technology:** The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art medical equipment, providing cutting-edge treatment options.
**Expert Medical Team:** A team of highly qualified and experienced doctors and healthcare professionals dedicated to patient well-being.
**Patient-Centric Approach:** Focused on delivering personalized care tailored to individual patient needs and preferences.
**Community Engagement:** Actively involved in health awareness programs and community health initiatives to promote wellness.
**Trusted Reputation:** Known for its commitment to quality care and patient satisfaction, building long-term trust with the community.

gap_list.title: LOW ONLINE PRESENCE
gap_list.desc: Without a dedicated website, the hospital misses out on reaching potential patients searching for healthcare services online, leading to lost opportunities.

gap_list.title: MANUAL WHATSAPP REPLIES
gap_list.desc: Current manual response system on WhatsApp leads to slow reply times, risking patient dissatisfaction and potential loss of inquiries.

gap_list.title: SLOW RESPONSE TIME
gap_list.desc: Delayed responses to patient inquiries can result in missed appointments and reduced patient trust in the hospital's services.

gap_list.title: LACK OF GOOGLE BUSINESS OPTIMIZATION
gap_list.desc: Not optimized on Google Business, making it difficult for patients to find accurate information or reviews, affecting new patient acquisition.

gap_list.title: NO DIGITAL ENGAGEMENT STRATEGY
gap_list.desc: Absence of a digital engagement strategy results in low visibility and interaction with potential patients on social media platforms.

current_gaps.current_messaging: Basic service descriptions without engaging content or call-to-action elements.
current_gaps.buyer_questions: What are the available specialties? How can I book an appointment? What are the hospital's visiting hours?

automation_tracking.title: Automated Appointment Booking System
automation_tracking.desc: A system that allows patients to book appointments online, reducing manual scheduling and improving patient convenience.

automation_tracking.title: Patient Feedback & Review Dashboard
automation_tracking.desc: A platform to collect and analyze patient feedback, enhancing service quality and patient satisfaction.

whatsapp_setup.title: WhatsApp Business Platform (Urgent)
bullets: Auto Welcome & Interactive Menu: Instant welcoming replies sending appointment booking links as soon as a patient contacts.
Quick Replies for FAQs: One-click shortcut answers for common inquiries like visiting hours, doctor availability, and services offered.
Customer Lead Tagging: Auto-labelling chats (e.g. New Patient, Follow-up, Emergency) to streamline patient management and follow-ups.
whatsapp_setup.benefit: By setting up interactive reply systems, business response speed increases to 100%, capturing patient inquiries and improving satisfaction.
